about: Website (chatcomputer.ai) eval cases: the first thing a visitor types, each in a fresh visit. Dimensions: intent (finding out what this is; trying something it does; asking anything, as of any AI; getting it on their computer; testing its limits; small talk; odd input; needing the internet: something recent, or looked up; which AI answers, and how to choose it), and phrasing (terse, a full sentence, a need rather than a request, typos, another language). 'expect' is what would count as a good answer; it guides the review. A case with 'turns' is a conversation: each turn typed after the answer to the one before (the first from a visitor's own conversation on the site).
